acceptanceCriteria: The rc.3 release notes name each recorded-limit item with its limit and cite decision 0523.
docs/CHANGE-EVIDENCE-MAP.md positioning section carries the section 6 MUST NOT list and the kill criteria.
The listed tickets carry a note pointing at decision 0523 for their rc.3 disposition.
body: Source: decision 0523 (docs/decisions/0523-cem-1-0-rc3-verifier-computed-support-2026-10-11.md) and build-log docs/build-log/2026-10-11-cem-1-0-expert-panel.md, origin/main fb11b2274. Under decision 0521 section 2 and decision 0523 section 3: V1-0592, V1-0594, V1-0612, V1-0620, V1-0622 and V1-0593 except go test ship as recorded limits; the CEM-V1-006 all-runners matrix is decoupled from the V1-0595 wire freeze; V1-0632 is reduced to verify/status/report plus the portable consumer; V1-0596 promotion stays owner-blocked. The release notes and docs/CHANGE-EVIDENCE-MAP.md carry the decision 0523 section 6 list of what an ACCEPT does not prove, and no rc.3 text says CEM helps reviewers or is groundbreaking until the trial reads met.
title: rc.3 release notes: record the decision 0523 scope amendment (recorded-limit items, CEM-V1-006 decoupled from the freeze, consumer MUST NOT list)
